description: Armor bases by type and slot. Damage-type affinities per armor type are in Damage Types.

fields.name: value
fields.help: Base price in copper (shop sells for this, buys for half).

fields.name: attribute_target
fields.help: Stat(s) raised while equipped (pairs with attribute_increase).

fields.name: attribute_increase
fields.help: Number, or a list matching attribute_target, e.g. [3, 5].

fields.name: class_restriction
fields.help: Classes that can equip it (heroes and enemies).

fields.name: effects
fields.help: Flat secondary bonuses, e.g. dodge -0.04, spell_power 2, armor_penetration 0.2.

fields.name: rarity
fields.help: Leave empty: rarity is rolled when the item drops.
